description: 한국교통안전공단_지역별 버스 충전소 설치현황 [bus and public transit and electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국교통안전공단. 정부 및 지자체는 탄소중립 등을 위해 친환경 교통수단 확대를 위한 정책을 지속적으로 추진에 따라 CNG, 전기, 수소와 같은 친환경 저상버스 차량이 도입되고 있으며, 별도의 충전 인프라가. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국교통안전공단. Its tags are 교통약자, 지역별, 버스충전소, CNG, 전기. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
